_doc: Neutral en-us writer placeholders for expEvent_celeb_town.json. Keys match zh-cn; legacy keys retained.

en-us.exp_event_erav_celeb_town_ongoing: Cameras are already set up in the district, and a private image review waits for final confirmation.
en-us.exp_event_erav_celeb_town_result: The image review is over; the record keeps only the choice made at the time.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_town_01:
The daytime job is 'tour guide': a sheer top worn over nothing, a microskirt over a single string. She walks in the middle of the group, shoulder grasped, waist held in turns, with hands slipping up under the skirt to steady her - 'so she doesn't fall'.
Harajuku, Shibuya, Omotesando - the itinerary is packed, and the shutters never stop.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_town_02:
At streetwear shops and gacha machines she is hugged into group photos, arranged into gestures.
When the lead rapper's mood strikes, she is told to pull her neckline low at the storefront and shape her mouth a certain way. She complies. Passersby raise their phones - nobody finds it odd; it must be some show filming.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_town_03:
Strangers' phones, the entourage's phones, the manager's ever-raised phone - she cannot tell which footage goes where.
"See? Tokyo girls, so open!"
en-us.event_erav_celeb_town_04:
At day's end the manager smooths her skirt down like putting away a prop.
"Tomorrow night, the club. Wear yesterday's shorter one."
On the itinerary, 'Japanese girlfriend' is followed by a whole week of fully booked 'engagements'.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_town_err: [ERROR] Scene targets missing (no party, or the client could not be borrowed from the Kiryu-gumi).
en-us.event_erav_celeb_town_writer_opening: The visit to the district is not public. There is only a camera crew and an image record waiting for approval. She knows what the lens will keep, but not who will interpret the record later.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_town_writer_choose_full: Cooperate with the review and confirm that the private record may be used.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_town_writer_choose_skip: Refuse the review and do not let the footage define her private image.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_town_writer_question: The cameras are ready, but the record's use has not been explained. Cooperate with the review?
en-us.event_erav_celeb_town_writer_summary_com: She completes the review and inspects the record left on site. No one decides whether it was right for her, but the choice is recorded.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_town_writer_summary_fai: The review does not finish cleanly. The cameras are put away, and unconfirmed footage cannot be treated as her official image.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_town_writer_summary_ski: She refuses the review. The district carries on, while the unauthorized cameras remain where they were stopped.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_town_writer_summary_err: The use of the record cannot be confirmed, so the review is halted. An unfinished check cannot be described as permission.
